description: Set the windows, doors and facade panels of ONE facade of a block (replaces that facade's list; [] clears it). Kinds: window, door, patio-door (glazed door), garage-door, panel (a flat panel of another finish, e.g. wooden cladding between windows — give material and color). Measure from the photos in proportion to known sizes (a door is about 2.05 × 0.95 m). Windows in a gable above the eaves go on that gable's facade. House frame: stand in front of the house facing its front facade; x runs to your right, z towards you, metres from the main block's centre. Facades: front, back, left, right as seen from the front. An opening's offset is measured on its own facade standing outside facing it: from that facade's LEFT end to the opening's centre.

frameColor.description: Hex colour as seen in daylight, e.g. #e9e7e1

offset.description: From the facade's left end (seen from outside) to the centre, m

surround.description: A flat band around a window or door

color.description: Hex colour as seen in daylight, e.g. #e9e7e1
